methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 high-search electric space heater models spanning ceramic, infrared, oil-filled, and fan/vortex types; Govee Smart Heater models H7130-H7135 were excluded due to a prior CPSC recall (fire/burn hazard). Specs were re-verified primarily against official manufacturer product pages (dreo.com, lasko.com, vornado.com, heatstorm.com, drheaterusa.com, honeywellstore.com) with corroboration from major retailers (Amazon, Home Depot, Walmart, Lowe's, Best Buy, Ace Hardware) and independent reviews. Booleans indicate verified presence (true) or confirmed absence (false); null indicates no verifiable data found. Wattage figures are maximum rated watts; coverage figures are manufacturer-stated or retailer-confirmed square footage; priceUsd is the published US MSRP or typical buy-it-now price found on a manufacturer or major retailer page at time of research, set to null where no reliable live published price exists (e.g. discontinued models). accessedAt 2026-06-19. Corrections applied vs draft: Dreo Atom One heat_settings 4->5; De'Longhi EW7707CM tip_over_protection null->true; Honeywell HCE200W priceUsd 42.99->null (discontinued); Dr Infrared DR-988 priceUsd 139.99->129.99 (manufacturer page).

products.name: Dreo Solaris Slim H3 (ALCI)
products.provenance: Re-verified on official Dreo product page: 700-1500W range, 5 modes (H1/H2/H3/ECO/Fan), 41-95°F adjustable thermostat in 1°F increments, 70° oscillation, ALCI plug with tip-over and overheat protection. Price $84.99 confirmed live on dreo.com. Coverage ~200 sqft per product positioning and independent review. No official release date stated (null).

products.name: Dreo Atom One
products.provenance: Re-verified on official Dreo page: 900-1500W, FIVE modes (High/Medium/Low/ECO/Fan) - draft's heat_settings of 4 corrected to 5. 41-95°F adjustable thermostat, 70° oscillation, tip-over protection, 12h timer. Coverage ~200 sqft per multiple review sources. Price $49.99 confirmed on dreo.com. Release year 2022 inferred from Amazon ASIN B0B3MXGBVT (B0B-era listing) rather than an official launch announcement.

products.name: Vornado VH200
products.priceNote: Typical retail at Home Depot and Walmart
products.provenance: Verified via Vornado product page and retailer corroboration: 3 heat settings at 750W/1125W/1500W, Vortex Heat Circulation (no oscillation), 7-position mechanical thermostat, tip-over switch confirmed, cool-touch exterior, 5-year warranty. Coverage ~150 sqft per Ace Hardware spec (retailer/marketing figures vary 75-150 personal, some cite up to 500); 150 retained as conservative retailer-confirmed value. Price ~$69.99 at Home Depot (~$70) and Walmart.

products.name: Lasko 754200
products.provenance: Re-verified on official Lasko product page: 900W low / 1500W high plus fan-only mode (2 heat settings), 11-position adjustable thermostat, 100 sq ft coverage. Lasko page explicitly lists 'No Tip Over Switch' (the 754201 successor adds it). No oscillation. Price $39.99 confirmed on lasko.com.

products.name: Lasko 6435 Designer Series
products.provenance: Re-verified on official Lasko page: 900W low / 1500W high (2 heat settings), widespread oscillation, adjustable thermostat, 7-hour timer, remote control included, 150 sqft coverage, automatic overheat protection. Lasko safety list states 'No Tip Over Switch' (manufacturer spec takes precedence over retailer listings claiming otherwise). Price $69.99 confirmed on lasko.com.

products.name: De'Longhi EW7707CM ComfortTemp
products.priceNote: Typical retail price across major retailers
products.provenance: Re-verified: permanently-sealed oil-filled radiator, 1500W with 3 heat settings (low/medium/high), ComfortTemp energy-saving mode (~20% savings), adjustable thermostat, fanless/silent operation, no oscillation. CORRECTION: tip_over_protection changed from null to true - the official De'Longhi instruction manual and multiple safety review sources confirm a tip-over safety switch (plus overheat and anti-freeze protection). First available July 2006 per Amazon listing. Price ~$129.95 across retailers.

products.name: Honeywell HCE200W UberHeat
products.priceNote: Discontinued by manufacturer; no reliable live published price
products.provenance: Re-verified: 1500W ceramic personal heater, 2 heat settings (Max/Low), adjustable thermostat, auto-off tip-over switch confirmed, overheat protection, cool-touch housing, no oscillation, coverage not stated by manufacturer (null). CORRECTION: priceUsd changed from 42.99 to null - the Honeywell store page now lists this model as DISCONTINUED with a suggested replacement, so there is no reliable manufacturer/major-retailer published price for the exact model (a null beats a stale guess). Product itself is genuine and specs hold.

products.name: Heat Storm HS-1500-PHX Phoenix
products.provenance: Re-verified on official Heat Storm product page (manufacturer model A-1500-PHXG; HS-1500-PHX is the retail/Lowe's-Home-Depot SKU for the non-WiFi variant): 3 modes (1500W full / 750W half / Auto), touch-screen digital thermostat, tip-over safety shut-off confirmed, no oscillation, safe-to-touch grill. Coverage 150 sqft as primary heat (up to 750 sqft supplemental). Price $139.99 confirmed on heatstorm.com.

products.name: Dr Infrared Heater DR-988
products.priceNote: Manufacturer price on drheaterusa.com (sale from $169.99); 240V industrial unit
products.provenance: Re-verified on drheaterusa.com: 240V industrial/garage infrared heater, 4800W at 208V / 5600W at 240V, NEMA 6-30P plug requiring dedicated 30A circuit, thermostat adjustable 37-113°F with fan ON/AUTO modes, portable or wall/ceiling mountable, auto overheat cut-off, UL/C-UL listed. Coverage ~600 sqft per Northern Tool and other retailers. Discrete heat 'settings' not enumerated (continuous thermostat) so heat_settings null. Tip-over protection not mentioned by manufacturer (null). CORRECTION: priceUsd changed from 139.99 to 129.99 to match the manufacturer's current published price (down from $169.99 MSRP).

products.name: Amazon Basics 1500W Oscillating Ceramic Heater
products.priceNote: Current 2026 price not verifiable from a live storefront; historically ~$17-$35 on Amazon
products.provenance: Re-verified from Amazon product descriptions (B07V4FNHCD / B07V7QJG8J): 1500W ceramic, 3 modes (High 1500W / Low 900W / Fan Only), 45° oscillation, adjustable thermostat, tip-over protection, overheat protection, 43 dB, 7.52"D x 6.34"W x 9.45"H. Coverage not stated by manufacturer (null). Current 2026 price not confirmable from a live storefront; historical deal prices ~$17-$35, priceUsd kept null.

products.name: Vornado MVH (2025)
products.provenance: Re-verified on official vornado.com product page: 2025 model designation, Vortex Heat Circulation, 3 heat settings (750W/1125W/1500W; Low/Medium/High), mechanical thermostat knob, tip-over switch and 2-stage auto-shutoff confirmed, no oscillation, cool-touch exterior, 5-year limited warranty. Coverage not stated on manufacturer page (null). MSRP $74.99 confirmed on vornado.com (Amazon list/sale $59.99). Source URL updated to the canonical vornado.com 2025 product page.
